issues.description: Method return type mismatch for messageOnMilk(): The problem statement (UML and textual spec) and the template's Main usage expect messageOnMilk() to return a String containing the phrase "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (see problem_statement.md lines 51-53 and 93-95). The solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type boolean (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java line 5) and the Seal and Goat implementations also return boolean while printing the message (Seal.java lines 19-22, Goat.java lines 15-18). This inconsistency will confuse students about the expected API: following the problem statement leads to a different method signature than the solution, and tests or example code that print the returned value (template Main.java lines 30-32) assume a String return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the API so all artifacts agree. Preferred fix (preserves problem statement and template behavior): change the solution repository's Milkable interface to declare messageOnMilk() returning String, and update its implementations (Seal and Goat) to return the formatted String "[Animal Type] {name} is milked" instead of printing and returning boolean. Example: in Milkable.java use 'String messageOnMilk();' and in Seal/Goat return "Seal Clarabelle is milked" / "Goat Buttinsky is milked". Alternatively, if boolean semantics were intended, update the problem statement, UML, and template Main to reflect a boolean return and not to print the return value. Prefer the first option to match the explicit textual requirement in the problem statement.
